kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
verses.translation_en: I am all-devouring Death; I am the Origin of all that will happen; I am Fame, Fortune, Speech, Memory, Intellect, Constancy, and Forgiveness.

verses.sanskrit:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम्।
मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasāmaham
māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo'hamṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ
verses.translation_en: Of hymns, I am Brihatsama; of meters, I am Garatri; among months, I am Margasheersha (December); and I am Spring among seasons.

verses.sanskrit:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।
जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम्॥
verses.transliteration:
dyūtaṃ chalayatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham
jayo'smi vyavasāyo'smi sattvaṃ sattvavatāmaham
verses.translation_en: I am the gambler's cheat and the splendor of the splendid; I am victory; I am effort; and I am the purity of the pure.

verses.sanskrit:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः॥
verses.transliteration:
vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo'smi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ
munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ
verses.translation_en: I am Shri Krishna among the Vishnu-clan, Arjuna among the Pandavas, Vyasa among the saints, and Shukracharya among the sages.

verses.sanskrit:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्॥
verses.transliteration:
daṇḍo damayatāmasmi nītirasmi jigīṣatām
maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatāmaham
verses.translation_en: I am the scepter of rulers, the strategy of conquerors, the silence of mystery, and the wisdom of the wise.

verses.sanskrit:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्॥
verses.transliteration:
yaccāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tadahamarjuna
na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram
verses.translation_en: I am the seed of all beings, O Arjuna! No creature, moving or unmoving, can live without Me.

verses.sanskrit:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परंतप।
एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया॥
verses.transliteration:
nānto'sti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paraṃtapa
eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūtervistaro mayā
verses.translation_en: O Arjuna! The aspects of My divine life are endless; I have mentioned only a few as an example.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम्॥
verses.transliteration:
yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā
tattadevāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejoṃ'śasaṃbhavam
verses.translation_en: Whatever is glorious, excellent, beautiful, and mighty, be assured that it comes from a fragment of My splendor.

verses.sanskrit:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्॥
verses.transliteration:
athavā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna
viṣṭabhyāhamidaṃ kṛtsnamekāṃśena sthito jagat
verses.translation_en: But what is the use of all these details to you, O Arjuna? I sustain this universe with only a small part of Myself.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच
मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम्।
यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca
madanugrahāya paramaṃ guhyamadhyātmasaṃjñitam
yattvayoktaṃ vacastena moho'yaṃ vigato mama
verses.translation_en: Arjuna said: My Lord! Your words concerning the Supreme Secret of Self, given for my blessing, have dispelled the illusions that surrounded me.

verses.sanskrit:
भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया।
त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम्॥
verses.transliteration:
bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā
tvattaḥ kamalapatrākṣa māhātmyamapi cāvyayam
verses.translation_en: O Lord, whose eyes are like the lotus petal! You have described in detail the origin and dissolution of beings, and Your own Eternal Majesty.

verses.sanskrit:
एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर।
द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम॥
verses.transliteration:
evametadyathāttha tvamātmānaṃ parameśvara
draṣṭumicchāmi te rūpamaiśvaraṃ puruṣottama
verses.translation_en: I believe all as you have declared it. I now long to have a vision of your divine form, O Most High!

verses.sanskrit:
मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो।
योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयाऽत्मानमव्ययम्॥
verses.transliteration:
manyase yadi tacchakyaṃ mayā draṣṭumiti prabho
yogeśvara tato me tvaṃ darśayā'tmānamavyayam
verses.translation_en: If you think it is possible for me to see it, show me, O Lord of Lords, your eternal self.

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच
पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च॥
verses.transliteration:
śrī bhagavānuvāca
paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
nānāvidhāni divyāni nānāvarṇākṛtīni ca
verses.translation_en: Lord Shri Krishna replied: "Behold, O Arjuna! My celestial forms, by the hundreds and thousands, various in kind, color, and shape."

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्िवनौ मरुतस्तथा।
बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याऽश्चर्याणि भारत॥
verses.transliteration:
paśyādityānvasūnrudrānaśivanau marutastathā
bahūnyadṛṣṭapūrvāṇi paśyā'ścaryāṇi bhārata
verses.translation_en: Behold, thou seest the powers of Nature: fire, earth, wind, and sky; the sun, the heavens, the moon, the stars; all forces of vitality and healing; and the roving winds. Behold, thou seest the myriad wonders revealed to none but thee.

verses.sanskrit:
इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम्।
मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद्द्रष्टुमिच्छसि॥
verses.transliteration:
ihaikasthaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ paśyādya sacarācaram
mama dehe guḍākeśa yaccānyaddraṣṭumicchasi
verses.translation_en: Here, living in Me, O Arjuna, behold the entire universe, both movable and immovable, and anything else you would like to see!

verses.sanskrit:
न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा।
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्॥
verses.transliteration:
na tu māṃ śakyase draṣṭumanenaiva svacakṣuṣā
divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogamaiśvaram
verses.translation_en: Yet, since you cannot see Me with mortal eyes, behold, I give you divine sight. Now, see the glory of My sovereignty.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच
एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः।
दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम्॥
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca
evamuktvā tato rājanmahāyogeśvaro hariḥ
darśayāmāsa pārthāya paramaṃ rūpamaiśvaram
verses.translation_en: Sanjaya continued: "Having thus spoken, O King, the Lord Shri Krishna, the Almighty Prince of Wisdom, showed Arjuna the Supreme Form of the Great God.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम्।
अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम्॥
verses.transliteration:
anekavaktranayanamanekādbhutadarśanam
anekadivyābharaṇaṃ divyānekodyatāyudham
verses.translation_en: There were countless eyes, mouths, and innumerable mystic forms, with shining ornaments and flaming celestial weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्।
सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम्॥
verses.transliteration:
divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ divyagandhānulepanam
sarvāścaryamayaṃ devamanantaṃ viśvatomukham
verses.translation_en: Crowned with heavenly garlands, clothed in shining garments, anointed with divine unguents, He showed Himself as the Resplendent One, Marvelous, Boundless, and Omnipresent.

verses.sanskrit:
दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता।
यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः॥
verses.transliteration:
divi sūryasahasrasya bhavedyugapadutthitā
yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syādbhāsastasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation_en: Could a thousand suns blaze forth together, it would be but a faint reflection of the radiance of the Lord God.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा।
अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा॥
verses.transliteration:
tatraikasthaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ pravibhaktamanekadhā
apaśyaddevadevasya śarīre pāṇḍavastadā
verses.translation_en: In that vision, Arjuna saw the universe, with its manifold shapes, all embraced in one, its Supreme Lord.

verses.sanskrit:
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः।
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत॥
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo hṛṣṭaromā dhanañjayaḥ
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
verses.translation_en: Then, Arjuna, filled with awe, his hair standing on end, bowing his head, and clasping his hands in reverence, spoke to the Lord:

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच
पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे
सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान्।
ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ
मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान्॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca
paśyāmi devāṃstava deva dehe
sarvāṃstathā bhūtaviśeṣasaṅghān
brahmāṇamīśaṃ kamalāsanastha
mṛṣīṃśca sarvānuragāṃśca divyān
verses.translation_en: Arjuna said: O Almighty God! I see in You the powers of Nature, the various creatures of the world, the Progenitor on His lotus throne, the Sages, and the shining angels.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं
पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम्।
नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं
पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप॥
verses.transliteration:
anekabāhūdaravaktranetraṃ
paśyāmi tvāṃ sarvato'nantarūpam
nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punastavādiṃ
paśyāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpa
verses.translation_en: I see You, infinite in form, with faces, eyes, and limbs everywhere; with no beginning, middle, or end. O You, Lord of the Universe, whose form is universal!

verses.sanskrit:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च
तेजोराशिं सर्वतोदीप्तिमन्तम्।
पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ता
द्दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम्॥
verses.transliteration:
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ ca
tejorāśiṃ sarvatodīptimantam
paśyāmi tvāṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ samantā
ddīptānalārkadyutimaprameyam
verses.translation_en: I see you with the crown, the scepter, and the discus; a blaze of splendor. Scarcely can I gaze upon you, so radiant you are, glowing like a blazing fire, brilliant as the sun, immeasurable.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।
त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता
सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे॥
verses.transliteration:
tvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ
tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam
tvamavyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā
sanātanastvaṃ puruṣo mato me
verses.translation_en: You are imperishable, the only one worthy of being known, the priceless treasure-house of the universe, the immortal guardian of eternal life, and the everlasting spirit.

verses.sanskrit:
अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य
मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम्।
पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रम्
स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम्॥
verses.transliteration:
anādimadhyāntamanantavīrya
manantabāhuṃ śaśisūryanetram
paśyāmi tvāṃ dīptahutāśavaktram
svatejasā viśvamidaṃ tapantam
verses.translation_en: Without beginning, without middle, and without end, infinite in power, with arms all-embracing, the sun and moon as Your eyes, Your face beaming with the fire of sacrifice, flooding the whole universe with light.

verses.sanskrit:
द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि
व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः।
दृष्ट्वाऽद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं
लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन्॥
verses.transliteration:
dyāvāpṛthivyoridamantaraṃ hi
vyāptaṃ tvayaikena diśaśca sarvāḥ
dṛṣṭvā'dbhutaṃ rūpamugraṃ tavedaṃ
lokatrayaṃ pravyathitaṃ mahātman
verses.translation_en: Alone, you fill all the quarters of the sky, earth, and heaven, and the regions between. O Almighty Lord! Seeing your marvelous and awe-inspiring form, the spheres tremble with fear.

verses.sanskrit:
अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घाः विशन्ति
केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति।
स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः
स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः॥
verses.transliteration:
amī hi tvāṃ surasaṅghāḥ viśanti
kecidbhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti
svastītyuktvā maharṣisiddhasaṅghāḥ
stuvanti tvāṃ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ
verses.translation_en: The troops of celestial beings enter into You, some invoking You in fear, with folded palms; the great seers and adepts sing hymns to Your glory, saying, "All hail!"

verses.sanskrit:
रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या
विश्वेऽश्िवनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च।
गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा
वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे॥
verses.transliteration:
rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā
viśve'śivanau marutaścoṣmapāśca
gandharvayakṣāsurasiddhasaṅghā
vīkṣante tvāṃ vismitāścaiva sarve
verses.translation_en: The vital forces, major stars, fire, earth, air, sky, sun, heaven, moon, and planets; the angels, guardians of the universe, divine healers, winds, fathers, heavenly singers, and hosts of mammon-worshippers, demons, and saints are all amazed.

verses.sanskrit:
रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं
महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम्।
बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं
दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाऽहम्॥
verses.transliteration:
rūpaṃ mahatte bahuvaktranetraṃ
mahābāho bahubāhūrupādam
bahūdaraṃ bahudaṃṣṭrākarālaṃ
dṛṣṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitāstathā'ham
verses.translation_en: Seeing Thy stupendous Form, O Most Mighty One, with its myriad faces, its innumerable eyes, limbs, and terrible jaws, I myself and all the worlds are overwhelmed with awe.

verses.sanskrit:
नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं
व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम्।
दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा
धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो॥
verses.transliteration:
nabhaḥspṛśaṃ dīptamanekavarṇaṃ
vyāttānanaṃ dīptaviśālanetram
dṛṣṭvā hi tvāṃ pravyathitāntarātmā
dhṛtiṃ na vindāmi śamaṃ ca viṣṇo
verses.translation_en: When I see You, touching the heavens, glowing with color, with open mouth and wide, fiery eyes, I am terrified. O my Lord! My courage and peace of mind abandon me.

verses.sanskrit:
दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि
दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि।
दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास॥
verses.transliteration:
daṃṣṭrākarālāni ca te mukhāni
dṛṣṭvaiva kālānalasannibhāni
diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma
prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
verses.translation_en: When I see Thy mouths with their fearful jaws, like glowing fires at the dissolution of creation, I lose all sense of place and find no rest. Be merciful, O Lord, in whom this universe abides!

verses.sanskrit:
अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः
सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः।
भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथाऽसौ
सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः॥
verses.transliteration:
amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ
sarve sahaivāvanipālasaṅghaiḥ
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ sūtaputrastathā'sau
sahāsmadīyairapi yodhamukhyaiḥ
verses.translation_en: All these sons of Dhritarashtra, along with the hosts of princes, Bheeshma, Drona, and Karna, as well as the other warrior chiefs on our side;

verses.sanskrit:
वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति
दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि।
केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु
संदृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः॥
verses.transliteration:
vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti
daṃṣṭrākarālāni bhayānakāni
kecidvilagnā daśanāntareṣu
saṃdṛśyante cūrṇitairuttamāṅgaiḥ
verses.translation_en: 1	See them all rushing headlong into Thy mouths, with terrible tusks, horrible to behold. Some are mangled between Thy jaws, with their heads crushed to atoms.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः
समुद्रमेवाभिमुखाः द्रवन्ति।
तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा
विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā nadīnāṃ bahavo'mbuvegāḥ
samudramevābhimukhāḥ dravanti
tathā tavāmī naralokavīrā
viśanti vaktrāṇyabhivijvalanti
verses.translation_en: As rivers in flood surge furiously towards the ocean, so these heroes, the greatest among men, fling themselves into Thy flaming mouths.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा
विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः।
तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोका
स्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā pradīptaṃ jvalanaṃ pataṅgā
viśanti nāśāya samṛddhavegāḥ
tathaiva nāśāya viśanti lokā
stavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛddhavegāḥ
verses.translation_en: As moths impetuously fly towards the flame, only to be killed, so these men rush into Your mouths to court their own destruction.

verses.sanskrit:
लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ता
ल्लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः।
तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं
भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो॥
verses.transliteration:
lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantā
llokānsamagrānvadanairjvaladbhiḥ
tejobhirāpūrya jagatsamagraṃ
bhāsastavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣṇo
verses.translation_en: You seem to swallow up the worlds, lapping them in flame. Your glory fills the universe. Your fierce rays beat down upon it irresistibly.

verses.sanskrit:
आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो
नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद।
विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं
न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम्॥
verses.transliteration:
ākhyāhi me ko bhavānugrarūpo
namo'stu te devavara prasīda
vijñātumicchāmi bhavantamādyaṃ
na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛttim
verses.translation_en: Tell me then, who are You, who wears this dreadful form? I bow before You, O Mighty One! Have mercy, I pray, and let me see You as You were at first. I do not know what Your intentions are.

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो
लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः।
ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे
येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः॥
verses.transliteration:
śrī bhagavānuvāca
kālo'smi lokakṣayakṛtpravṛddho
lokānsamāhartumiha pravṛttaḥ
ṛte'pi tvāṃ na bhaviṣyanti sarve
ye'vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ
verses.translation_en: Lord Shri Krishna replied: I have shown myself to you as the Destroyer who lays waste the world and whose purpose is destruction. In spite of your efforts, all these warriors gathered for battle shall not escape death.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व
जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम्।
मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव
निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmāttvamuttiṣṭha yaśo labhasva
jitvā śatrūn bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ samṛddham
mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvameva
nimittamātraṃ bhava savyasācin
verses.translation_en: Then gird up your loins and conquer. Subdue your foes and enjoy the kingdom in prosperity. I have already doomed them. Be thou my instrument, Arjuna!

verses.sanskrit:
द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च
कर्णं तथाऽन्यानपि योधवीरान्।
मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा
युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान्॥
verses.transliteration:
droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca jayadrathaṃ ca
karṇaṃ tathā'nyānapi yodhavīrān
mayā hatāṃstvaṃ jahi mā vyathiṣṭhā
yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān
verses.translation_en: Drona, Bheeshma, Jayadratha, Karna, and other brave warriors - I have condemned them all. Destroy them; fight without fear. Your foes shall be crushed."

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य
कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी।
नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं
सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य॥
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca
etacchrutvā vacanaṃ keśavasya
kṛtāñjalirvepamānaḥ kirīṭī
namaskṛtvā bhūya evāha kṛṣṇaṃ
sagadgadaṃ bhītabhītaḥ praṇamya
verses.translation_en: Sanjaya continued: "Having heard these words from the Lord Shri Krishna, the Prince Arjuna, with folded hands trembling, prostrated himself and with a choked voice, bowing down again and again, and overwhelmed with awe, once more addressed the Lord.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच
स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या
जगत् प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च।
रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति
सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca
sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā
jagat prahṛṣyatyanurajyate ca
rakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti
sarve namasyanti ca siddhasaṅghāḥ
verses.translation_en: Arjuna said: My Lord! It is natural for the world to revel and rejoice when singing praises of Your glory; the demons fly in fear and the saints offer You their salutations.

verses.sanskrit:
कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्
गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे।
अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास
त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत्॥
verses.transliteration:
kasmācca te na nameranmahātman
garīyase brahmaṇo'pyādikartre
ananta deveśa jagannivāsa
tvamakṣaraṃ sadasattatparaṃ yat
verses.translation_en: How else should they do? O Supreme Self, greater than the powers of creation, the first cause, infinite, the Lord of Lords, the home of the universe, imperishable, being and non-being, yet transcending both.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराण
स्त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्।
वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम
त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप॥
verses.transliteration:
tvamādidevaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇa
stvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam
vettāsi vedyaṃ ca paraṃ ca dhāma
tvayā tataṃ viśvamanantarūpa
verses.translation_en: You are the Primal God, the Ancient One, the Supreme Abode of this universe, the Knower, the Knowledge, and the Final Home. You fill everything. Your form is infinite.

verses.sanskrit:
वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः
प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च।
नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः
पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते॥
verses.transliteration:
vāyuryamo'gnirvaruṇaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ
prajāpatistvaṃ prapitāmahaśca
namo namaste'stu sahasrakṛtvaḥ
punaśca bhūyo'pi namo namaste
verses.translation_en: You are the wind, you are death, you are the fire, the water, the moon, the father, and the grandfather. Honor and glory to you a thousand and a thousand times! Again and again, salutations to you, O my Lord!

verses.sanskrit:
नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते
नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व।
अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं
सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः॥
verses.transliteration:
namaḥ purastādatha pṛṣṭhataste
namo'stu te sarvata eva sarva
anantavīryāmitavikramastvaṃ
sarvaṃ samāpnoṣi tato'si sarvaḥ
verses.translation_en: Salutations to Thee in front and on all sides, Thou who encompasseth me round about. Thy power is infinite; Thy majesty immeasurable; Thou upholdest all things; indeed, Thou Thyself art All.

verses.sanskrit:
सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं
हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति।
अजानता महिमानं तवेदं
मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि॥
verses.transliteration:
sakheti matvā prasabhaṃ yaduktaṃ
he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti
ajānatā mahimānaṃ tavedaṃ
mayā pramādātpraṇayena vāpi
verses.translation_en: Whatever I have said to you in rashness, taking you only as a friend and addressing you as “O Krishna! O Yadava! O Friend!” in thoughtless familiarity, without understanding your greatness;

verses.sanskrit:
यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि
विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु।
एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं
तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम्॥
verses.transliteration:
yaccāvahāsārthamasatkṛto'si
vihāraśayyāsanabhojaneṣu
eko'thavāpyacyuta tatsamakṣaṃ
tatkṣāmaye tvāmahamaprameyam
verses.translation_en: Whatever insults I have offered to You in jest, in sport, in repose, in conversation, or at a banquet, alone or in a crowd, I ask for Your forgiveness for them all, O You Who are without equal!

verses.sanskrit:
पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य
त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान्।
न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो
लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव॥
verses.transliteration:
pitāsi lokasya carācarasya
tvamasya pūjyaśca gururgarīyān
na tvatsamo'styabhyadhikaḥ kuto'nyo
lokatraye'pyapratimaprabhāva
verses.translation_en: For you are the Father of all things movable and immovable, the Worshipful, the Master of Masters! In all the worlds, there is none equal to you; how then could there be one superior, O you who stand alone, Supreme?

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं
प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम्।
पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः
प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम्॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmātpraṇamya praṇidhāya kāyaṃ
prasādaye tvāmahamīśamīḍyam
piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ
priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum
verses.translation_en: Therefore, I prostrate myself before You, O Lord! Most Adorable! I salute You, and I ask for Your blessing. Only You can be trusted to bear with me, like a father to a son, like a friend to a friend, and like a lover to his beloved.

verses.sanskrit:
अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा
भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे।
तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास॥
verses.transliteration:
adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hṛṣito'smi dṛṣṭvā
bhayena ca pravyathitaṃ mano me
tadeva me darśaya deva rūpaṃ
prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
verses.translation_en: I rejoice that I have seen what no man has ever seen before; yet, O Lord! I am overwhelmed with fear. Please take on the form I know. Be merciful, O Lord! You who are the home of the entire universe.

verses.sanskrit:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्त
मिच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव।
तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन
सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते॥
verses.transliteration:
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakrahasta
micchāmi tvāṃ draṣṭumahaṃ tathaiva
tenaiva rūpeṇa caturbhujena
sahasrabāho bhava viśvamūrte
verses.translation_en: I long to see Thee as Thou wert before, with the crown, the scepter, and the discus in Thy hands; in Thy other form, with Thy four hands, O Thou whose arms are countless and whose forms are infinite.

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच
मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं
रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात्।
तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं
यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम्॥
verses.transliteration:
śrī bhagavānuvāca
mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṃ
rūpaṃ paraṃ darśitamātmayogāt
tejomayaṃ viśvamanantamādyaṃ
yanme tvadanyena na dṛṣṭapūrvam
verses.translation_en: Lord Shri Krishna replied: My beloved friend! It is only through My grace and power that you have been able to see this vision of splendour, the Universal, the Infinite, the Original. Never has it been seen by anyone else.

verses.sanskrit:
न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानै
र्न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः।
एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके
द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर॥
verses.transliteration:
na vedayajñādhyayanairna dānai
rna ca kriyābhirna tapobhirugraiḥ
evaṃrūpaḥ śakya ahaṃ nṛloke
draṣṭuṃ tvadanyena kurupravīra
verses.translation_en: It is not possible for man on earth to see what thou hast seen, O thou foremost hero of the Kuru-clan, through study of the scriptures, sacrifice or gift, ritual or rigorous austerity!

verses.sanskrit:
मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो
दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम्।
व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं
तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य॥
verses.transliteration:
mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍhabhāvo
dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ghoramīdṛṅmamedam
vyapetabhīḥ prītamanāḥ punastvaṃ
tadeva me rūpamidaṃ prapaśya
verses.translation_en: Do not be afraid or confused by the terrible vision. Put away your fear and, with a joyful mind, see Me again in My usual form.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच
इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा
स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः।
आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं
भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा॥
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca
ityarjunaṃ vāsudevastathoktvā
svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa bhūyaḥ
āśvāsayāmāsa ca bhītamenaṃ
bhūtvā punaḥ saumyavapurmahātmā
verses.translation_en: Sanjaya continued: "Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Lord Shri Krishna showed Himself again in His accustomed form; and the Mighty Lord, in gentle tones, softly consoled him who had recently trembled with fear.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच
दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तवसौम्यं जनार्दन।
इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca
dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ tavasaumyaṃ janārdana
idānīmasmi saṃvṛttaḥ sacetāḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ
verses.translation_en: Arjuna said: Seeing You in Your gentle human form, my Lord, I am myself again, calm once more.

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच
सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम।
देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः॥
verses.transliteration:
śrī bhagavānuvāca
sudurdarśamidaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavānasi yanmama
devā apyasya rūpasya nityaṃ darśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation_en: Lord Shri Krishna replied: It is difficult to see the vision of Me that thou hast seen. Even the most powerful have longed for it in vain.

verses.sanskrit:
नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया।
शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा॥
verses.transliteration:
nāhaṃ vedairna tapasā na dānena na cejyayā
śakya evaṃvidho draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭavānasi māṃ yathā
verses.translation_en: It is not possible to see Me as you have done through studying the scriptures, performing austerities, giving gifts, or making sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit:
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्यमहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन।
ज्ञातुं दृष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप॥
verses.transliteration:
bhaktyā tvananyayā śakyamahamevaṃvidho'rjuna
jñātuṃ dṛṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca paraṃtapa
verses.translation_en: Only through tireless devotion can I be seen and known; only in this way can a person become one with Me, O Arjuna!

verses.sanskrit:
मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः।
निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव॥
verses.transliteration:
matkarmakṛnmatparamo madbhaktaḥ saṅgavarjitaḥ
nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa māmeti pāṇḍava
verses.translation_en: He who does every action for My sake, to whom I am the final goal, who loves Me alone and hates no one—O My dearest son, only he can realize Me!

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचएवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते।येचाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः॥
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvācaevaṃ satatayuktā ye bhaktāstvāṃ paryupāsateyecāpyakṣaramavyaktaṃ teṣāṃ ke yogavittamāḥ
verses.translation_en: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, which are the better devotees who worship You: those who try to know You as a Personal God, or those who worship You as Impersonal and Indestructible?"

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचमय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः॥
verses.transliteration: śrī bhagavānuvācamayyāveśya mano ye māṃ nityayuktā upāsateśraddhayā parayopetāste me yuktatamā matāḥ
verses.translation_en: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Those who keep their minds fixed on Me, who worship Me always with unwavering faith and concentration, are the very best.

verses.sanskrit: ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते।सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम्॥
verses.transliteration: ye tvakṣaramanirdeśyamavyaktaṃ paryupāsatesarvatragamacintyaṃ ca kūṭasthamacalaṃ dhruvam
verses.translation_en: Those who worship Me as the Indestructible, the Undefinable, the Omnipresent, the Unthinkable, the Primal, the Immutable, and the Eternal;

verses.sanskrit: संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः।ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः॥
verses.transliteration: saṃniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ sarvatra samabuddhayaḥte prāpnuvanti māmeva sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
verses.translation_en: Subduing their senses, viewing all conditions of life with an equal eye, and working for the welfare of all beings, they assuredly come to Me.

verses.sanskrit:
क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम्।
अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते॥
verses.transliteration:
kleśo'dhikatarasteṣāmavyaktāsaktacetasām
avyaktā hi gatirduḥkhaṃ dehavadbhiravāpyate
verses.translation_en: But they who fix their attention on the Absolute and Impersonal encounter greater hardships, for it is difficult for those who have a body to realize Me as without one.

verses.sanskrit: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः।अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते॥
verses.transliteration: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparāḥananyenaiva yogena māṃ dhyāyanta upāsate
verses.translation_en: Verily, those who surrender their actions to Me, who contemplate Me, worship Me, and meditate on Me alone, with no thought other than Me.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात्।भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम्॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā mṛtyusaṃsārasāgarātbhavāmi nacirātpārtha mayyāveśitacetasām
verses.translation_en: O Arjuna! I rescue them from the ocean of life and death, for their minds are fixed upon Me.

verses.sanskrit: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय।निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः॥
verses.transliteration: mayyeva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṃ niveśayanivasiṣyasi mayyeva ata ūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation_en: Then let your mind cling only to Me, let your intellect abide in Me; and without doubt, you will live hereafter in Me alone.

verses.sanskrit: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्।अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय॥
verses.transliteration: atha cittaṃ samādhātuṃ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiramabhyāsayogena tato māmicchāptuṃ dhanañjaya
verses.translation_en: But if you cannot fix your mind firmly on Me, then, my beloved friend, try to do so through constant practice.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव।मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन् सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि॥
verses.transliteration: abhyāse'pyasamartho'si matkarmaparamo bhavamadarthamapi karmāṇi kurvan siddhimavāpsyasi
verses.translation_en: And if you are not strong enough to practice concentration, then devote yourself to My service, do all your acts for My sake, and you will still attain the goal.

verses.sanskrit: अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः।सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्॥
verses.transliteration: athaitadapyaśakto'si kartuṃ madyogamāśritaḥsarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān
verses.translation_en: And if thou art too weak to do even this, then seek refuge in union with Me, and with perfect self-control renounce the fruits of thy actions.

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते।ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम्॥
verses.transliteration: śreyo hi jñānamabhyāsājjñānāddhyānaṃ viśiṣyatedhyānātkarmaphalatyāgastyāgācchāntiranantaram
verses.translation_en: Knowledge is superior to blind action, meditation is superior to knowledge, renunciation of the fruit of action is superior to meditation, and peace follows from renunciation.

verses.sanskrit: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी॥
verses.transliteration: adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva canirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ samaduḥkhasukhaḥ kṣamī
verses.translation_en: He who is incapable of hatred towards any being, who is kind and compassionate, free from selfishness, without pride, equable in pleasure and pain, and forgiving—

verses.sanskrit: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः।मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः॥
verses.transliteration: santuṣṭaḥ satataṃ yogī yatātmā dṛḍhaniścayaḥmayyarpitamanobuddhiryo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.translation_en: Always content, self-centered, self-controlled, resolute, with mind and reason dedicated to Me, such a devotee of Mine is beloved to Me.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः॥
verses.transliteration: yasmānnodvijate loko lokānnodvijate ca yaḥharṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ
verses.translation_en: He who does not harm the world, and whom the world cannot harm, who is not carried away by any impulse of joy, anger, or fear; such a one is My beloved.

verses.sanskrit: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः॥
verses.transliteration: anapekṣaḥ śucirdakṣa udāsīno gatavyathaḥsarvārambhaparityāgī yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.translation_en: He who expects nothing, is pure, watchful, indifferent, unruffled, and renounces all initiative—such a one is My beloved.

verses.sanskrit: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्ितमान्यः स मे प्रियः॥
verses.transliteration: yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣatiśubhāśubhaparityāgī bhakitamānyaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.translation_en: He who is beyond joy and hate, who neither laments nor desires, to whom good and evil fortunes are the same, such a one is beloved to Me.

verses.sanskrit: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः॥
verses.transliteration: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥśītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu samaḥ saṅgavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation_en: He to whom friend and foe are alike, who welcomes equally honor and dishonor, heat and cold, pleasure and pain, and who is enamored of nothing—

verses.sanskrit: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येनकेनचित्।अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्ितमान्मे प्रियो नरः॥
verses.transliteration: tulyanindāstutirmaunī santuṣṭo yenakenacitaniketaḥ sthiramatirbhakitamānme priyo naraḥ
verses.translation_en: Who is indifferent to praise and censure, enjoys silence, is content with every fate, has no fixed abode, is steadfast in mind, and filled with devotion—such a one is My beloved.

verses.sanskrit: ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते।श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः॥
verses.transliteration: ye tu dharmyāmṛtamidaṃ yathoktaṃ paryupāsateśraddadhānā matparamā bhaktāste'tīva me priyāḥ
verses.translation_en: Verily, those who love the spiritual wisdom as I have taught, whose faith never wavers, and who focus their entire being on Me, they are indeed My most beloved.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च।
एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव॥
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñameva ca
etadveditumicchāmi jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ ca keśava
verses.translation_en: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, who is God, what is Nature, what is Matter, and what is the Self? What is Wisdom, and what is worth knowing? I wish to have this explained."

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचइदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते।एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः॥
verses.transliteration: śrī bhagavānuvācaidaṃ śarīraṃ kaunteya kṣetramityabhidhīyateetadyo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ
verses.translation_en: Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Arjuna! The body of a person is the playground of the Self; and That which knows the activities of Matter, sages call the Self.

verses.sanskrit:
क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम॥
verses.transliteration:
kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata
kṣetrakṣetrajñayorjñānaṃ yattajjñānaṃ mataṃ mama
verses.translation_en: I am the omniscient Self that abides in the realm of matter; knowledge of matter and of the all-knowing Self is wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्।स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे श्रृणु॥
verses.transliteration: tatkṣetraṃ yacca yādṛk ca yadvikāri yataśca yatsa ca yo yatprabhāvaśca tatsamāsena me śrṛṇu
verses.translation_en: What is called Matter, of what it is composed, whence it came, and why it changes, what the Self is, and what its power - this I will now briefly set forth.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक्।ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्िचतैः॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣibhirbahudhā gītaṃ chandobhirvividhaiḥ pṛthakbrahmasūtrapadaiścaiva hetumadbhirviniśicataiḥ
verses.translation_en: Seers have sung of it in various ways, in many hymns and sacred Vedic songs, weighty in thought and convincing in their arguments.

verses.sanskrit: महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च।इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः॥
verses.transliteration: mahābhūtānyahaṅkāro buddhiravyaktameva caindriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca pañca cendriyagocarāḥ
verses.translation_en: The five great fundamentals—earth, fire, air, water, and ether—personality, intellect, the mysterious life force, the ten organs of perception and action, the mind, and the five domains of sensation—

verses.sanskrit: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतनाधृतिः।एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्॥
verses.transliteration: icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṅghātaścetanādhṛtiḥetatkṣetraṃ samāsena savikāramudāhṛtam
verses.translation_en: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, sympathy, vitality, and the persistent clinging to life—these are, in brief, the constituents of changing matter.

verses.sanskrit: अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्।आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः॥
verses.transliteration: amānitvamadambhitvamahiṃsā kṣāntirārjavamācāryopāsanaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyamātmavinigrahaḥ
verses.translation_en: Humility, sincerity, harmlessness, forgiveness, rectitude, service to the Master, purity, steadfastness, and self-control;

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च।जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम्॥
verses.transliteration: indriyārtheṣu vairāgyamanahaṅkāra eva cajanmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhadoṣānudarśanam
verses.translation_en: Renouncing the delights of the senses, being without pride, having a right understanding of the painful problem of birth and death, and of age and sickness;

verses.sanskrit: असक्ितरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु।नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु॥
verses.transliteration: asakitaranabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣunityaṃ ca samacittatvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu
verses.translation_en: Indifference, non-attachment to sex, progeny, or home, equanimity in both good fortune and bad;

verses.sanskrit: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्ितरव्यभिचारिणी।विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि॥
verses.transliteration: mayi cānanyayogena bhakitaravyabhicāriṇīviviktadeśasevitvamaratirjanasaṃsadi
verses.translation_en: Unswerving devotion to Me, with concentration on Me and Me alone, a love for solitude, and indifference to social life;

verses.sanskrit: अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम्।एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोन्यथा॥
verses.transliteration: adhyātmajñānanityatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanametajjñānamiti proktamajñānaṃ yadatonyathā
verses.translation_en: Constant yearning for the knowledge of the Self, and pondering over the lessons of the great Truth—this is wisdom; all else is ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वाऽमृतमश्नुते।अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते॥
verses.transliteration: jñeyaṃ yattatpravakṣyāmi yajjñātvā'mṛtamaśnuteanādimatparaṃ brahma na sattannāsaducyate
verses.translation_en: I will now speak to you of that great truth which one ought to know, since by it one will attain immortal bliss—that which is without beginning, the eternal spirit which dwells in me, neither with form nor without it.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम्।सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति॥
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tatsarvato'kṣiśiromukhamsarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati
verses.translation_en: Everywhere are Its hands and feet; everywhere It has eyes that see, heads that think, and mouths that speak; everywhere It listens; It dwells in all the worlds and envelops them all.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम्।असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च॥
verses.transliteration: sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitamasaktaṃ sarvabhṛccaiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca
verses.translation_en: Beyond the senses, it yet shines through every sense perception; bound to nothing, it yet sustains everything; unaffected by the qualities, it still enjoys them all.

verses.sanskrit: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च।सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत्॥
verses.transliteration: bahirantaśca bhūtānāmacaraṃ carameva casūkṣmatvāttadavijñeyaṃ dūrasthaṃ cāntike ca tat
verses.translation_en: It is within all beings, yet outside; motionless yet moving; too subtle to be perceived; far away yet ever near.

verses.sanskrit: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्।भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च॥
verses.transliteration: avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitambhūtabhartṛ ca tajjñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca
verses.translation_en: In all beings, undivided yet living in division, it is the upholder of all, both creator and destroyer alike.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते।ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम्॥
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣāmapi tajjyotistamasaḥ paramucyatejñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam
verses.translation_en: It is the light of lights, beyond the reach of darkness; the wisdom, the only thing worth knowing or that wisdom can teach; the presence in the hearts of all.

verses.sanskrit: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः।मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते॥
verses.transliteration: iti kṣetraṃ tathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ coktaṃ samāsataḥmadbhakta etadvijñāya madbhāvāyopapadyate
verses.translation_en: Thus, I have briefly told you what Matter is, the Self worth realizing, and what Wisdom is. He who is devoted to Me knows, and he will assuredly enter into Me.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि।विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवान्॥
verses.transliteration: prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva viddhyanādī ubhāvapivikārāṃśca guṇāṃścaiva viddhi prakṛtisaṃbhavān
verses.translation_en: Know further that Nature and God have no beginning, and that differences in character and quality originate from Nature only.

verses.sanskrit: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते।पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते॥
verses.transliteration: kāryakāraṇakartṛtve hetuḥ prakṛtirucyatepuruṣaḥ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ bhoktṛtve heturucyate
verses.translation_en: Nature is the law that generates cause and effect; God is the source of all pleasure and pain.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान्।कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु॥
verses.transliteration: puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi bhuṅkte prakṛtijānguṇānkāraṇaṃ guṇasaṅgo'sya sadasadyonijanmasu
verses.translation_en: God, dwelling in the heart of Nature, experiences the qualities that Nature brings forth; and His affinity towards these qualities is the reason for His living in a good or evil body.

verses.sanskrit: उपद्रष्टाऽनुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः।परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः॥
verses.transliteration: upadraṣṭā'numantā ca bhartā bhoktā maheśvaraḥparamātmeti cāpyukto dehe'sminpuruṣaḥ paraḥ
verses.translation_en: Thus, in the body of man dwells the Supreme God; He who sees, permits, upholds, and enjoys is the Highest God and the Highest Self.

verses.sanskrit: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैःसह।सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते॥
verses.transliteration: ya evaṃ vetti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca guṇaiḥsahasarvathā vartamāno'pi na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate
verses.translation_en: He who understands God and Nature, along with her qualities, whatever his condition in life may be, will not come back to earth.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना।अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे॥
verses.transliteration: dhyānenātmani paśyanti kecidātmānamātmanāanye sāṃkhyena yogena karmayogena cāpare
verses.translation_en: Some realize the Supreme by meditating, with its aid, on the Self within; others by pure reason; and still others by right action.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वाऽन्येभ्य उपासते।तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः॥
verses.transliteration: anye tvevamajānantaḥ śrutvā'nyebhya upāsatete'pi cātitarantyeva mṛtyuṃ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation_en: Others, again, having no direct knowledge but only hearing from others, still worship, and, if they are true to the teachings, they too will cross the sea of death.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्।क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ॥
verses.transliteration: yāvatsañjāyate kiñcitsattvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamamkṣetrakṣetrajñasaṃyogāttadviddhi bharatarṣabha
verses.translation_en: Wherever life is seen in things movable or immovable, it is the result of the combination of Matter and Spirit.

verses.sanskrit: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्।विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति॥
verses.transliteration: samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaramvinaśyatsvavinaśyantaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
verses.translation_en: He who can see the Supreme Lord in all beings, the Imperishable amidst the perishable, he is the one who truly sees.

verses.sanskrit: समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्।न हिनस्त्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्॥
verses.transliteration: samaṃ paśyanhi sarvatra samavasthitamīśvaramna hinastyātmanā''tmānaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatim
verses.translation_en: Beholding the Lord equally in all things, his actions do not mar his spiritual life but lead him to the heights of bliss.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः।यः पश्यति तथाऽऽत्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति॥
verses.transliteration: prakṛtyaiva ca karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥyaḥ paśyati tathā''tmānamakartāraṃ sa paśyati
verses.translation_en: He who understands that it is only the Law of Nature that brings action to fruition, and that the Self never acts, alone knows the Truth.

verses.sanskrit: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा॥
verses.transliteration: yadā bhūtapṛthagbhāvamekasthamanupaśyatitata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma sampadyate tadā
verses.translation_en: He who sees the diverse forms of life all rooted in One and growing forth from Him, shall indeed find the Absolute.

verses.sanskrit: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः।शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते॥
verses.transliteration: anāditvānnirguṇatvātparamātmāyamavyayaḥśarīrastho'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
verses.translation_en: The Supreme Spirit, O Prince, is without beginning, has no qualities, and is imperishable. Though it is within the body, it does not act, nor is it affected by action.

verses.sanskrit: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते।सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यते॥
verses.transliteration: yathā sarvagataṃ saukṣmyādākāśaṃ nopalipyatesarvatrāvasthito dehe tathā''tmā nopalipyate
verses.translation_en: As space, though present everywhere, remains unaffected due to its subtlety, so too the Self, though present in all forms, retains its purity unalloyed.

verses.sanskrit: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः।क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत॥
verses.transliteration: yathā prakāśayatyekaḥ kṛtsnaṃ lokamimaṃ raviḥkṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata
verses.translation_en: As the one Sun illuminates the entire earth, so the Lord illuminates the entire universe.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा।भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्॥
verses.transliteration: kṣetrakṣetrajñayorevamantaraṃ jñānacakṣuṣābhūtaprakṛtimokṣaṃ ca ye viduryānti te param
verses.translation_en: Those who, with the eyes of wisdom, thus see the difference between Matter and Spirit, and know how to liberate life from the Law of Nature, attain the Supreme.

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचपरं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्।यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः॥
verses.transliteration: śrī bhagavānuvācaparaṃ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi jñānānāṃ jñānamuttamamyajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ
verses.translation_en: Lord Shri Krishna continued: Now I will reveal to you the wisdom that is beyond knowledge, by attaining which the sages have reached perfection.

verses.sanskrit: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः।सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च॥
verses.transliteration: idaṃ jñānamupāśritya mama sādharmyamāgatāḥsarge'pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca
verses.translation_en: Dwelling in wisdom and realizing My divinity, they are not reborn when the universe is recreated at the beginning of every cycle, nor are they affected when it is dissolved.

verses.sanskrit: मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्यहम्।संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत॥
verses.transliteration: mama yonirmahadbrahma tasmin garbhaṃ dadhāmyahamsaṃbhavaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tato bhavati bhārata
verses.translation_en: The eternal cosmos is My womb, in which I plant the seed from which all beings are born, O prince!

verses.sanskrit: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः।तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता॥
verses.transliteration: sarvayoniṣu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥtāsāṃ brahma mahadyonirahaṃ bījapradaḥ pitā
verses.translation_en: O illustrious son of Kunti! Through whatever wombs men are born, it is the Spirit itself that conceives, and I am their father.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः।निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्॥
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ rajastama iti guṇāḥ prakṛtisaṃbhavāḥnibadhnanti mahābāho dehe dehinamavyayam
verses.translation_en: Purity, passion, and ignorance are the qualities that the law of nature brings forth. They fetter the free spirit in all beings.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्।सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ॥
verses.transliteration: tatra sattvaṃ nirmalatvātprakāśakamanāmayamsukhasaṅgena badhnāti jñānasaṅgena cānagha
verses.translation_en: O Sinless One! Of these, purity, being luminous, strong, and invulnerable, binds one with its yearning for happiness and illumination.

verses.sanskrit: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्।तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्॥
verses.transliteration: rajo rāgātmakaṃ viddhi tṛṣṇāsaṅgasamudbhavamtannibadhnāti kaunteya karmasaṅgena dehinam
verses.translation_en: Passion, engendered by thirst for pleasure and attachment, binds the soul through its fondness for activities.

verses.sanskrit: तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्।प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत॥
verses.transliteration: tamastvajñānajaṃ viddhi mohanaṃ sarvadehināmpramādālasyanidrābhistannibadhnāti bhārata
verses.translation_en: But Ignorance, the product of darkness, stupefies the senses of all embodied beings, binding them with chains of folly, indolence, and lethargy.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत।ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत॥
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhāratajñānamāvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayatyuta
verses.translation_en: Purity brings happiness, passion brings commotion, and ignorance, which obscures wisdom, leads to a life of failure.

verses.sanskrit: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत।रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा॥
verses.transliteration: rajastamaścābhibhūya sattvaṃ bhavati bhāratarajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaścaiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā
verses.translation_en: O Prince! Purity prevails when passion and ignorance are overcome; passion, when purity and ignorance are overcome; and ignorance when it is overcome by purity and passion.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत॥
verses.transliteration: sarvadvāreṣu dehe'sminprakāśa upajāyatejñānaṃ yadā tadā vidyādvivṛddhaṃ sattvamityuta
verses.translation_en: When the light of knowledge gleams forth from all the gates of the body, then be sure that purity prevails.

verses.sanskrit: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा।रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ॥
verses.transliteration: lobhaḥ pravṛttirārambhaḥ karmaṇāmaśamaḥ spṛhārajasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe bharatarṣabha
verses.translation_en: O best of Indians! Avarice, the impulse to act, and the beginning of action itself are all due to the dominance of passion.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च।तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन॥
verses.transliteration: aprakāśo'pravṛttiśca pramādo moha eva catamasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe kurunandana
verses.translation_en: Darkness, stagnation, folly, and infatuation are the results of the dominance of ignorance, O joy of the Kuru clan!

verses.sanskrit: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्।तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते॥
verses.transliteration: yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛttadottamavidāṃ lokānamalānpratipadyate
verses.translation_en: When purity prevails, the soul, upon leaving the body, passes on to the pure regions where those who know the Highest reside.

verses.sanskrit: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते।तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते॥
verses.transliteration: rajasi pralayaṃ gatvā karmasaṅgiṣu jāyatetathā pralīnastamasi mūḍhayoniṣu jāyate
verses.translation_en: When passion prevails, the soul is reborn among those who love activity; when ignorance rules, it enters the wombs of the ignorant.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्।रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्॥
verses.transliteration: karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṃ nirmalaṃ phalamrajasastu phalaṃ duḥkhamajñānaṃ tamasaḥ phalam
verses.translation_en: They say the fruit of a meritorious action is spotless and pure; the outcome of passion is misery, and of ignorance, darkness.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च।प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च॥
verses.transliteration: sattvātsañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva capramādamohau tamaso bhavato'jñānameva ca
verses.translation_en: Purity engenders wisdom, passion avarice, and ignorance folly, infatuation, and darkness.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः।जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः॥
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥjaghanyaguṇavṛttisthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ
verses.translation_en: When purity is in the ascendant, the man evolves; when passion is in the ascendant, he neither evolves nor degenerates; when ignorance is in the ascendant, he is lost.

verses.sanskrit: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति।गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति॥
verses.transliteration: nānyaṃ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṃ yadā draṣṭānupaśyatiguṇebhyaśca paraṃ vetti madbhāvaṃ so'dhigacchati
verses.translation_en: As soon as one understands that it is only the qualities that act and nothing else, and perceives that which is beyond, they attain My divine nature.

verses.sanskrit: गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान्।जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते॥
verses.transliteration: guṇānetānatītya trīndehī dehasamudbhavānjanmamṛtyujarāduḥkhairvimukto'mṛtamaśnute
verses.translation_en: When the soul transcends the Qualities, which are the real cause of physical existence, then, freed from birth and death, from old age and misery, he drinks the nectar of immortality.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचकैर्लिंगैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो।किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते॥
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvācakairliṃgaistrīnguṇānetānatīto bhavati prabhokimācāraḥ kathaṃ caitāṃstrīnguṇānativartate
verses.translation_en: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, how can one recognize someone who has transcended the qualities? How do they act and live beyond them?"

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचप्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव।न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति॥
verses.transliteration: śrī bhagavānuvācaprakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍavana dveṣṭi sampravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati
verses.translation_en: Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Prince! He who does not shun the quality that is present and does not long for that which is absent;

verses.sanskrit: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते।गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते॥
verses.transliteration: udāsīnavadāsīno guṇairyo na vicālyateguṇā vartanta ityeva yo'vatiṣṭhati neṅgate
verses.translation_en: He who maintains an attitude of indifference, who is not disturbed by the qualities, who realizes that it is only they who act, and remains calm;

verses.sanskrit: समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः॥
verses.transliteration: samaduḥkhasukhaḥ svasthaḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥtulyapriyāpriyo dhīrastulyanindātmasaṃstutiḥ
verses.translation_en: Who accepts pain and pleasure as they come, is centered in their Self, to whom a piece of clay, stone, or gold are all the same, who neither likes nor dislikes, who is steadfast, indifferent alike to praise or censure;

verses.sanskrit: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते॥
verses.transliteration: mānāpamānayostulyastulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥsarvārambhaparityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation_en: Who looks equally upon honor and dishonor, loves friends and foes alike, and abandons all initiative, such is he who transcends the qualities.

verses.sanskrit: मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्ितयोगेन सेवते।स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
verses.transliteration: māṃ ca yo'vyabhicāreṇa bhakitayogena sevatesa guṇānsamatītyaitān brahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.translation_en: And he who serves Me alone, with unwavering devotion, shall overcome the Qualities and become one with the Eternal.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाऽहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च।शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च॥
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhā'hamamṛtasyāvyayasya caśāśvatasya ca dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya ca
verses.translation_en: For I am the home of the spirit, the continual source of immortality, eternal righteousness, and infinite joy.

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्।छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्॥
verses.transliteration: śrī bhagavānuvācaūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhamaśvatthaṃ prāhuravyayamchandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
verses.translation_en: Lord Shri Krishna continued: This phenomenal creation, which is both ephemeral and eternal, is like a tree, with its seed above in the Highest and its ramifications below on this earth. The scriptures are its leaves, and he who understands this knows.

verses.sanskrit: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा     गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः।अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि     कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके॥
verses.transliteration: adhaścordhvaṃ prasṛtāstasya śākhā     guṇapravṛddhā viṣayapravālāḥadhaśca mūlānyanusantatāni     karmānubandhīni manuṣyaloke
verses.translation_en: Its branches shoot upwards and downwards, deriving their nourishment from the qualities; its buds are the objects of sense; and its roots, which follow the law, causing man's regeneration and degeneration, pierce downwards into the soil.

verses.sanskrit: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते    नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा।अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूल    मसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा॥
verses.transliteration: na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate    nānto na cādirna ca saṃpratiṣṭhāaśvatthamenaṃ suvirūḍhamūla    masaṅgaśastreṇa dṛḍhena chittvā
verses.translation_en: In this world, its true form is not known, neither its origin nor its end, and its strength is not understood—until the tree, with its roots striking deep into the earth, is hewn down by the sharp axe of non-attachment.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्य    यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः।तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये    यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavya    yasmingatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥtameva cādyaṃ puruṣaṃ prapadye    yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī
verses.translation_en: Beyond lies the path, from which, once found, there is no return. This is the Primal God from whom this ancient creation has sprung.

verses.sanskrit: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा    अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः।द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञै    र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत्॥
verses.transliteration: nirmānamohā jitasaṅgadoṣā    adhyātmanityā vinivṛttakāmāḥdvandvairvimuktāḥ sukhaduḥkhasaṃjñai    rgacchantyamūḍhāḥ padamavyayaṃ tat
verses.translation_en: The wise attain Eternity when, freed from pride and delusion, they have conquered their love for the things of sense; when, renouncing desire and fixing their gaze on the Self, they cease to be tossed to and fro by the opposing sensations, such as pleasure and pain.

verses.sanskrit: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः।यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम॥
verses.transliteration: na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥyadgatvā na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
verses.translation_en: Neither the sun, nor the moon, nor fire shines there. Those who go there never come back. For, O Arjuna, that is my celestial home!

verses.sanskrit: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः।मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति॥
verses.transliteration: mamaivāṃśo jīvaloke jīvabhūtaḥ sanātanaḥmanaḥṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛtisthāni karṣati
verses.translation_en: It is only a very small part of My Eternal Self, which is the life of the universe, that draws around itself the six senses, with the mind being the last, which have their source in Nature.

verses.sanskrit: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः।गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्॥
verses.transliteration: śarīraṃ yadavāpnoti yaccāpyutkrāmatīśvaraḥgṛhītvaitāni saṃyāti vāyurgandhānivāśayāt
verses.translation_en: When the Supreme Lord enters a body or leaves it, He gathers these senses together and travels with them, as the wind gathers perfume while passing through the flowers.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च।अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते॥
verses.transliteration: śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇameva caadhiṣṭhāya manaścāyaṃ viṣayānupasevate
verses.translation_en: He is the perception of the ear, the eye, the touch, the taste, the smell, and the mind; and the enjoyment of the things they perceive is also His.

verses.sanskrit: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्।विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः॥
verses.transliteration: utkrāmantaṃ sthitaṃ vāpi bhuñjānaṃ vā guṇānvitamvimūḍhā nānupaśyanti paśyanti jñānacakṣuṣaḥ
verses.translation_en: The ignorant do not see that it is He who is present in life and departs at death, or even that it is He who enjoys pleasure through the qualities. Only the eye of wisdom sees this.

verses.sanskrit: यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्।यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः॥
verses.transliteration: yatanto yoginaścainaṃ paśyantyātmanyavasthitamyatanto'pyakṛtātmāno nainaṃ paśyantyacetasaḥ
verses.translation_en: The saints, with great effort, find Him within themselves; however, the unintelligent, despite their efforts, cannot control their minds.

verses.sanskrit: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्।यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्॥
verses.transliteration: yadādityagataṃ tejo jagadbhāsayate'khilamyaccandramasi yaccāgnau tattejo viddhi māmakam
verses.translation_en: Remember that the light which proceeds from the sun, illuminating the whole world, and the light which is in the moon, and that which is in the fire, all are born of me.

verses.sanskrit: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः॥
verses.transliteration: gāmāviśya ca bhūtāni dhārayāmyahamojasāpuṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
verses.translation_en: I enter this world and animate all My creatures with My vitality; and by My cool moonbeams, I nourish the plants.

verses.sanskrit: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः।प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्॥
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ vaiśvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṃ dehamāśritaḥprāṇāpānasamāyuktaḥ pacāmyannaṃ caturvidham
verses.translation_en: Becoming the fire of life, I pass into their bodies and, uniting with the vital streams of Prāṇa and Apāna, I digest the various kinds of food.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो    मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च।वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो    वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्॥
verses.transliteration: sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭo    mattaḥ smṛtirjñānamapohanaṃ cavedaiśca sarvairahameva vedyo    vedāntakṛdvedavideva cāham
verses.translation_en: I am enthroned in the hearts of all; memory, wisdom, and discrimination owe their origins to Me. I am He Who is to be realized in the scriptures; I inspire their wisdom, and I know their truth.

verses.sanskrit: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च।क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते॥
verses.transliteration: dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva cakṣaraḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate
verses.translation_en: There are two aspects in Nature: the perishable and the imperishable. All life in this world belongs to the former, while the unchanging element belongs to the latter.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः।यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः॥
verses.transliteration: uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ paramātmetyudāhṛtaḥyo lokatrayamāviśya bibhartyavyaya īśvaraḥ
verses.translation_en: But I am higher than all, the Supreme God, the Absolute Self, the Eternal Lord, who pervades and upholds all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः।अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः॥
verses.transliteration: yasmātkṣaramatīto'hamakṣarādapi cottamaḥato'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation_en: I am beyond comparison with the Eternal and the non-eternal; I am known as the Supreme Personality, the Highest God, by scriptures and sages.

verses.sanskrit: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्।स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत॥
verses.transliteration: yo māmevamasammūḍho jānāti puruṣottamamsa sarvavidbhajati māṃ sarvabhāvena bhārata
verses.translation_en: He who, with unclouded vision, sees Me as the Lord-God, knows all that there is to be known and will always worship Me with his whole heart.

verses.sanskrit: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयाऽनघ।एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत॥
verses.transliteration: iti guhyatamaṃ śāstramidamuktaṃ mayā'naghaetadbuddhvā buddhimānsyātkṛtakṛtyaśca bhārata
verses.translation_en: Thus, O sinless one, I have revealed this most mystic knowledge to thee. He who understands it gains wisdom and attains the consummation of life.

verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिः ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः।
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्॥
verses.transliteration:
śrī bhagavānuvāca
abhayaṃ sattvasaṃśuddhiḥ jñānayogavyavasthitiḥ
dānaṃ damaśca yajñaśca svādhyāyastapa ārjavam
verses.translation_en: Lord Shri Krishna continued: Fearlessness, clean living, unceasing concentration on wisdom, readiness to give, self-control, a spirit of sacrifice, regular study of the scriptures, austerity, candor,

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्।दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्॥
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsā satyamakrodhastyāgaḥ śāntirapaiśunamdayā bhūteṣvaloluptvaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam
verses.translation_en: Harmlessness, truth, absence of wrath, renunciation, contentment, straightforwardness, compassion towards all, uncovetousness, courtesy, modesty, and constancy.

verses.sanskrit:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता।
भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत॥
verses.transliteration:
tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ śaucamadroho nātimānitā
bhavanti sampadaṃ daivīmabhijātasya bhārata
verses.translation_en: Valor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, freedom from hate and vanity—these are the qualities of one who possesses the divine, O Arjuna!

verses.sanskrit: दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च।अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम्॥
verses.transliteration: dambho darpo'bhimānaśca krodhaḥ pāruṣyameva caajñānaṃ cābhijātasya pārtha sampadamāsurīm
verses.translation_en: Hypocrisy, pride, insolence, cruelty, and ignorance belong to those born of godless qualities.

verses.sanskrit: दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता।मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव॥
verses.transliteration: daivī sampadvimokṣāya nibandhāyāsurī matāmā śucaḥ sampadaṃ daivīmabhijāto'si pāṇḍava
verses.translation_en: Godly qualities lead to liberation; godless ones lead to bondage. Do not be anxious, Prince! You have the Godly qualities.

verses.sanskrit: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च।दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श्रृणु॥
verses.transliteration: dvau bhūtasargau loke'smin daiva āsura eva cadaivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śrṛṇu
verses.translation_en: No changes needed.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः।न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते॥
verses.transliteration: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥna śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate
verses.translation_en: The godless do not know how to act or renounce; they lack both purity and truth. They do not understand the right principles of conduct.

verses.sanskrit: असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्।अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्॥
verses.transliteration: asatyamapratiṣṭhaṃ te jagadāhuranīśvaramaparasparasambhūtaṃ kimanyatkāmahaitukam
verses.translation_en: They say the universe is an accident with no purpose and no God. Life is created through sexual union, a product of lust and nothing else.

verses.sanskrit: एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः।प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः॥
verses.transliteration: etāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhya naṣṭātmāno'lpabuddhayaḥprabhavantyugrakarmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato'hitāḥ
verses.translation_en: Thinking thus, these degraded souls, these enemies of mankind—whose intelligence is negligible and whose deeds are monstrous—come into the world only to destroy.

verses.sanskrit: काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः।मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः॥
verses.transliteration: kāmamāśritya duṣpūraṃ dambhamānamadānvitāḥmohādgṛhītvāsadgrāhānpravartante'śucivratāḥ
verses.translation_en: Giving themselves up to insatiable passions, hypocritically, self-sufficiently, and arrogantly, cherishing false conceptions founded on delusion, they work only to carry out their own unholy purposes.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः।कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्िचताः॥
verses.transliteration: cintāmaparimeyāṃ ca pralayāntāmupāśritāḥkāmopabhogaparamā etāvaditi niśicatāḥ
verses.translation_en: Poring anxiously over evil resolutions that only end in death, seeking only the gratification of desire as the highest goal, and seeing nothing beyond—

verses.sanskrit: आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः।ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान्॥
verses.transliteration: āśāpāśaśatairbaddhāḥ kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥīhante kāmabhogārthamanyāyenārthasañcayān
verses.translation_en: Caught in the toils of a hundred vain hopes, enslaved by passion and wrath, they accumulate hoards of unjust wealth, only to indulge their sensual desires.

verses.sanskrit: इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्।इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्॥
verses.transliteration: idamadya mayā labdhamimaṃ prāpsye manorathamidamastīdamapi me bhaviṣyati punardhanam
verses.translation_en: Today I have gained this; tomorrow I will fulfill another desire; this wealth is mine now, and the rest will soon be mine.

verses.sanskrit: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि।ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी॥
verses.transliteration: asau mayā hataḥ śatrurhaniṣye cāparānapiīśvaro'hamahaṃ bhogī siddho'haṃ balavānsukhī
verses.translation_en: I have slain one enemy; I will slay the others too. I am worthy of enjoying; I am the Almighty, perfect, powerful, and happy.

verses.sanskrit: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया।यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः॥
verses.transliteration: āḍhyo'bhijanavānasmi ko'nyo'sti sadṛśo mayāyakṣye dāsyāmi modiṣya ityajñānavimohitāḥ
verses.translation_en: I am wealthy, I am of noble birth; who can compare with me? I will sacrifice, I will give, I will pay—and I will enjoy. Thus blinded by ignorance,

verses.sanskrit: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः।प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ॥
verses.transliteration: anekacittavibhrāntā mohajālasamāvṛtāḥprasaktāḥ kāmabhogeṣu patanti narake'śucau
verses.translation_en: Perplexed by discordant thoughts, entangled in the snares of desire, infatuated by passion, they sink into the depths of hell.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः।यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्॥
verses.transliteration: ātmasambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhanamānamadānvitāḥyajante nāmayajñaiste dambhenāvidhipūrvakam
verses.translation_en: Self-conceited, stubborn, wealthy, proud, and insolent, they make a show of their patronage, disregarding the norms of propriety.

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः।मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः॥
verses.transliteration: ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥmāmātmaparadeheṣu pradviṣanto'bhyasūyakāḥ
verses.translation_en: Puffed up by power and inordinate conceit, swayed by lust and wrath, these wicked people hate Me, Who am within them as I am within all.

verses.sanskrit: तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान्।क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु॥
verses.transliteration: tānahaṃ dviṣataḥ krūrānsaṃsāreṣu narādhamānkṣipāmyajasramaśubhānāsurīṣveva yoniṣu
verses.translation_en: Those who thus hate Me, who are cruel, the dregs of mankind, I condemn them to a continuous, miserable, and godless rebirth.

verses.sanskrit: असुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि।मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम्॥
verses.transliteration: asurīṃ yonimāpannā mūḍhā janmani janmanimāmaprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatim
verses.translation_en: So, reborn, they spend life after life enveloped in delusion, and they never reach Me, O Prince, but degenerate into even lower forms of life.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्॥
verses.transliteration: trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ dvāraṃ nāśanamātmanaḥkāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhastasmādetattrayaṃ tyajet
verses.translation_en: The gates of hell are three: lust, wrath, and avarice; they destroy the Self, so avoid them.

verses.sanskrit: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः।आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्॥
verses.transliteration: etairvimuktaḥ kaunteya tamodvāraistribhirnaraḥācaratyātmanaḥ śreyastato yāti parāṃ gatim
verses.translation_en: These are the gates that lead to darkness; if one avoids them, they will ensure their own welfare and eventually attain liberation.

verses.sanskrit: यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः।न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्॥
verses.transliteration: yaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥna sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim
verses.translation_en: But he who neglects the commands of the scriptures and follows the promptings of passion does not attain perfection, happiness, or the final goal.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ।ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि॥
verses.transliteration: tasmācchāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ te kāryākāryavyavasthitaujñātvā śāstravidhānoktaṃ karma kartumihārhasi
verses.translation_en: Therefore, whenever there is doubt as to whether you should do something or not, let the scriptures guide your conduct. In the light of the scriptures, you should labor your whole life.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः।तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः॥
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvācaye śāstravidhimutsṛjya yajante śraddhayā'nvitāḥteṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa sattvamāho rajastamaḥ
verses.translation_en: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, what is the condition of those who perform acts of sacrifice not according to the scriptures, but with implicit faith? Is it one of purity, passion, or ignorance?"

verses.sanskrit: श्री भगवानुवाचत्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा।सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां श्रृणु॥
verses.transliteration: śrī bhagavānuvācatrividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāvajāsāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śrṛṇu
verses.translation_en: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Man has an inherent faith in one or another of the qualities—purity, passion, and ignorance. Now, listen.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत।श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः॥
verses.transliteration: sattvānurūpā sarvasya śraddhā bhavati bhārataśraddhāmayo'yaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
verses.translation_en: Every person's faith conforms to their nature. By nature, they are full of faith. They are, in fact, what their faith makes them.

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः।प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः॥
verses.transliteration: yajante sāttvikā devānyakṣarakṣāṃsi rājasāḥpretānbhūtagaṇāṃścānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ
verses.translation_en: The pure worship the true God; the passionate, the powers of wealth and magic; the ignorant, the spirits of the dead and lower orders of nature.

verses.sanskrit: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः।दम्भाहङ्कारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः॥
verses.transliteration: aśāstravihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyante ye tapo janāḥdambhāhaṅkārasaṃyuktāḥ kāmarāgabalānvitāḥ
verses.translation_en: Those who practice austerities not commanded by scripture, who are enslaved to hypocrisy and egotism, who are carried away by the fury of desire and passion,

verses.sanskrit: कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः।मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्॥
verses.transliteration: karṣayantaḥ śarīrasthaṃ bhūtagrāmamacetasaḥmāṃ caivāntaḥśarīrasthaṃ tānviddhyāsuraniścayān
verses.translation_en: They are ignorant and torment the organs of the body, harassing Me who lives within. Know that they are devoted to evil.

verses.sanskrit: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः।यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं श्रृणु॥
verses.transliteration: āhārastvapi sarvasya trividho bhavati priyaḥyajñastapastathā dānaṃ teṣāṃ bhedamimaṃ śrṛṇu
verses.translation_en: The food that people enjoy is also threefold, like the ways of sacrifice, austerity, and almsgiving. Listen to the distinction.

verses.sanskrit: आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः।रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः॥
verses.transliteration: āyuḥsattvabalārogyasukhaprītivivardhanāḥrasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā āhārāḥ sāttvikapriyāḥ
verses.translation_en: The foods that prolong life, increase purity, vigour, health, cheerfulness, and happiness are those that are delicious, soothing, substantial, and agreeable; these are loved by the pure.

verses.sanskrit: कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः।आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः॥
verses.transliteration: kaṭvamlalavaṇātyuṣṇatīkṣṇarūkṣavidāhinaḥāhārā rājasasyeṣṭā duḥkhaśokāmayapradāḥ
verses.translation_en: Those in whom passion is dominant like foods that are bitter, sour, salty, overly hot, pungent, dry, and burning. These produce unhappiness, repentance, and disease.

verses.sanskrit: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्।उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्॥
verses.transliteration: yātayāmaṃ gatarasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ ca yatucchiṣṭamapi cāmedhyaṃ bhojanaṃ tāmasapriyam
